# TzWorld v2.3.0 - Table of Contents

Resolve time zone names from a location.

## Pages

- [TzWorld](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [CHANGELOG](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [Performance](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/performance.md)

## Modules

- [TzWorld](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/TzWorld.md): Resolve a timezone name from coordinates.
- [TzWorld.Backend](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/TzWorld.Backend.md): Defines the callbacks for the TzWorld.Backend
behaviour
- [TzWorld.Backend.SpatialIndex](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/TzWorld.Backend.SpatialIndex.md): Resolves timezones from a coordinate using an R-tree spatial index
held in `:persistent_term`.
- [TzWorld.Downloader](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/TzWorld.Downloader.md): Function to support downloading the latest
timezones geo JSON data
- [TzWorld.TimezoneFixtures](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/TzWorld.TimezoneFixtures.md): Coordinate fixtures used by the test suite and the benchmark.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix tz_world.update](https://tz-world.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TzWorld.Update.md): Downloads and installs the latest Timezone GeoJSON data.
